messages:
Incident Bot: Scheduled maintenance window for 'control-plane rolling restart' is starting now in us-west-2. Expected duration 60m. Paging on-call as a precaution. :warning:
Maria Chen: FYI — we moved the window 30m earlier to reduce customer impact. See the customer notice draft later in thread.
Ashok Patel: I'm seeing 3 nodes failing to drain (node-17, node-18, node-21). Drain command returning timeout after 2m.
Leo Martinez: On it. Can you paste the drain logs? I'll try a manual cordon + restart if needed.
Ashok Patel: Logs:```\n2025-03-12T15:22:01Z node-17 draining...\n2025-03-12T15:24:01Z drain timed out: pod gc stuck at terminating (kubelet)\n2025-03-12T15:24:05Z evict api returned 500: unable to evict\n```
Maria Chen: @Leo @Ashok we have a small group of customers on dedicated capacity in us-west-2 that could see elevated tail latency if drains don't finish. Need statuspage and CS draft prepared now.
Deploy Bot: Triggering fallback routing to healthy pools for impacted tenant IDs: tenant-984, tenant-1023. TTL ~ 20m.
Leo Martinez: Quick mitigation: manually scale up a pre-warmed standby pool and shift traffic. Commands I'm running:```bash\nkubectl cordon node-17\nkubectl drain node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=30\nrgctl start-standby-pool --region us-west-2 --size 2\n```
Ashok Patel: I hand-applied `--force` to complete drain on node-17, still stuck on node-18 due to kube-proxy hanging. Restarting kube-proxy on node-18 now.
Sarah Nguyen: Prep statuspage update (draft):
"We are performing a scheduled rolling restart of control-plane nodes in US-West-2. A subset of customers may experience brief elevated latencies while we complete node drains. Expected impact: intermittent increased inference latency for some dedicated hosts. Status: investigating. ETA: 30-45 minutes."
Rebecca (CS): Customer notification draft for the tenant admins (plain text):
"Hi — we're performing a scheduled maintenance in US-West-2 that may cause short periods of increased latency for dedicated instances. We're actively mitigating by routing traffic and performing targeted restarts. We'll post updates to status.redwood.ai. Apologies for the inconvenience. — Redwood Inference Ops" :email:
Maria Chen: Rebecca, add a line about rollback plan + contact: `If you see errors contact support@redwood.ai and include tenant ID.` Also tag customers with high SLA.
Tim O'Rourke: I'll queue the CS email for tenants with SLA>99.9 once we have confirmation that fallback routing is active.
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert sent to on-call: SRE-primary (Ashok). Incident ID: INC-20250312-447.
Leo Martinez: Kube-proxy restart fixed node-18 drain, node-21 required deleting a stuck terminating pod and reattempting drain. All three nodes now drained. Standby pool is up and traffic shifted.
Maria Chen: Status update for customers and statuspage: ready to post. Sarah, can you post the statuspage 'investigating -> identified, mitigation in place' update?
Sarah Nguyen: Posting update now. Statuspage entry: "Identified: node drains timing out due to stuck kube-proxy pods. Mitigation: restarted kube-proxy and shifted traffic to standby pools. Some customers may have transient latency. Monitoring. Next update in 30m or when resolved." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2025-03-12-ctrlplane-restart
Rebecca (CS): Sending targeted email to high-SLA tenants now (template approved).
Ashok Patel: Follow-up checks: KV cache priming completed, no error rate increase in logs, tail latency back to baseline for most tenants.
Deploy Bot: Rolling restart job completed on control-plane nodes in us-west-2. No further nodes in maintenance queue.
Maria Chen: Great work. Can we capture an internal post-mortem template in this thread? Quick bullet points: timeline, root cause (kube-proxy/flaky eviction), mitigation (kube-proxy restart, standby pool routing), customer comms notes, follow-ups (increase drain timeout, improve eviction handling, add prewarm pools in eu-central fallback).
Leo Martinez: I'll file the JIRA after this thread with labels: incident, maintenance, control-plane, follow-up.
Rebecca (CS): Logging customer responses: 2 customers acknowledged, no escalations so far.
Maria Chen: Marking maintenance complete. Final status: :white_check_mark: Maintenance finished, control-plane nodes healthy, no ongoing customer impact. Closing thread.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-20250312-447 closed by Maria Chen.
Maria Chen: P.s. quick ops note — bump the drain timeout to 5m in the next rolling restart runbook (ticket assigned).
